# Rever

> Rever is a pay-per-call toolbox of 39 website-intelligence endpoints for AI agents: give it a URL, get JSON back. Read pages as markdown or text, extract contacts, socials, metadata, sitemaps and structured data, audit SEO, AI-readiness, security headers, HTTPS and email security, look up DNS, WHOIS and Wayback history, detect tech stacks and trackers, check whether a crypto project's website looks legit, and turn a site's design into tokens, brand kits, screenshots or a prompt to rebuild its UI.

No account needed. AI agents pay per request ($0.001 to $0.05) in USDC on Base with the standard x402 protocol: any x402 client (e.g. `@x402/fetch`, Coinbase AgentKit) pays automatically. People buy a pack of generations by card on the website.

## How it works

- Every endpoint: `POST` with JSON `{"url": "https://..."}` (some take an extra option, see the OpenAPI spec). Response: JSON.
- Most answer in 1-3 s. You are only charged when the call succeeds.

## Services (39, all paid per call with x402)

### Read a page

- `/api/page-markdown` ($0.003): Convert any web page into clean Markdown for LLMs
- `/api/page-text` ($0.002): Get the plain visible text of a web page (no HTML, scripts or styles), whitespace-normalized, with title and word count
- `/api/meta` ($0.002): Get a page's metadata
- `/api/links` ($0.002): List every link on a web page with its anchor text, split into internal and external, with nofollow flags and the external domains linked to
- `/api/images` ($0.002): List the images on a web page with absolute URL, alt text, declared width/height and lazy-loading, plus counts of images missing alt text (accessibility/SEO)
- `/api/headings` ($0.001): Get the heading outline of a web page (H1-H6 in document order) with counts per level and structure warnings (no H1, several H1s, skipped levels)
- `/api/structured-data` ($0.003): Extract all structured data from a web page
- `/api/og-image` ($0.001): Get the social preview image of a page (what shows when a link is shared)
- `/api/favicon` ($0.001): Get the best favicon/icon for a website
- `/api/forms` ($0.002): List the forms on a web page
- `/api/feeds` ($0.003): Find a website's RSS/Atom feeds (declared links and common paths like /feed and /rss.xml) and return the latest items from the first one
- `/api/key-pages` ($0.002): Find the important pages of a website from its home page links
- `/api/language` ($0.001): Detect a web page's language
- `/api/text-stats` ($0.002): Text statistics for a web page's visible content

### Companies and leads

- `/api/company-info` ($0.005): Company profile from its website in one call
- `/api/contacts` ($0.003): Extract contact details from a web page
- `/api/social-links` ($0.002): Find a website's social media profiles
- `/api/tech-stack` ($0.005): Detect the technologies behind a website
- `/api/trackers` ($0.003): Detect analytics, ad and tracking scripts on a web page (Google Analytics/Tag Manager, Meta Pixel, TikTok, LinkedIn, Hotjar, Clarity, Segment, Mixpanel, HubSpot, Plausible...), cookie-consent tools and all third-party script domains

### SEO and site audits

- `/api/seo-audit` ($0.005): Quick on-page SEO audit with a 0-100 score
- `/api/ai-readiness` ($0.003): How readable is a website for AI agents? Checks llms.txt and llms-full.txt, AI crawler rules in robots.txt, sitemap, JSON-LD, whether content renders without JavaScript, OpenAPI, MCP and x402 manifests, with a 0-100 score and fixes
- `/api/broken-links` ($0.005): Check the links on a web page for broken ones
- `/api/sitemap` ($0.003): Get every URL a website lists in its XML sitemaps
- `/api/robots` ($0.002): Read and parse a website's robots.txt
- `/api/page-weight` ($0.002): Page performance basics without a browser
- `/api/redirects` ($0.002): Trace a URL's full redirect chain hop by hop (up to 10)

### Security, domain and network

- `/api/security-headers` ($0.002): Grade a website's HTTP security headers (A-F)
- `/api/https-check` ($0.002): Check a site's HTTPS setup
- `/api/dns` ($0.002): DNS lookup for a website's domain
- `/api/email-security` ($0.003): Check a domain's email setup and spoofing protection
- `/api/domain-whois` ($0.003): Domain registration data via RDAP (modern WHOIS)
- `/api/wayback` ($0.002): Internet Archive history of a website
- `/api/headers` ($0.001): Get the raw HTTP response headers of any URL, with status code, final URL after redirects and response time
- `/api/status` ($0.001): Is this website up? Returns up/down, HTTP status, response time in ms, final URL and content type

### Crypto

- `/api/crypto-site-check` ($0.02): Due-diligence check of a crypto project's website before you buy or interact

### Design and visuals

- `/api/generate-prompt` ($0.05): Turn any public website URL into a detailed prompt (layout, components, colors, typography, spacing) for recreating its UI with a code model such as Lovable, v0, Claude or Cursor
- `/api/design-tokens` ($0.02): Extract a website's design tokens as JSON
- `/api/brand-kit` ($0.01): Get a website's brand kit in one call
- `/api/screenshot` ($0.01): Screenshot any public web page

## API

- Base URL: `https://www.aypiai.online`
- [OpenAPI spec](https://www.aypiai.online/openapi.json)
- [x402 discovery manifest](https://www.aypiai.online/.well-known/x402.json)
- [Full agent guide](https://www.aypiai.online/llms-full.txt): payment options, errors, examples

## Payment (x402)

1. Call the endpoint without payment → HTTP 402 with a `PAYMENT-REQUIRED` header (x402 v2): scheme `exact`, network `eip155:8453` (Base), asset USDC, the amount of the endpoint (e.g. `1000` = $0.001).
2. Your x402 client signs a USDC authorization (gasless for you) and retries with the `PAYMENT-SIGNATURE` header.
3. You get the JSON result, plus a `PAYMENT-RESPONSE` header with the settlement receipt.

Other ways to pay: for `/api/generate-prompt` only: for `/api/generate-prompt` only: for `/api/generate-prompt` only: send 0.05 USDC on Base to the `payTo` address and retry with `X-Payment: <transaction hash>`, or use a pack key in `X-Access-Key`.

## Tools

- Remote MCP server: `https://www.aypiai.online/mcp` (Streamable HTTP): one tool per service (e.g. `page_markdown`, `crypto_site_check`, `clone_ui`) plus `list_services`. **Free tier: 20 calls per day per user on all tools priced $0.005 or less, no signup or wallet.** Above that, or for premium tools, pay by passing an x402 `payment` argument, listed in the official MCP Registry as `online.aypiai.www/rever`
- [Local MCP server](https://github.com/chaoui-ahmed/rever-ui-cloner/tree/main/rever-mcp): `clone_ui` only, over stdio
- [MCP server card](https://www.aypiai.online/.well-known/mcp.json)

- [Web app](https://www.aypiai.online/): paste a URL, buy packs by card (10 generations for 9,99 €)
